name: mainline_source_neighbor_coverage_v1
geometry_rule: Existing legacy_public_coordinates(X_integer/100); mean squared distance in its first ten public coordinates; one non-self nearest neighbor per held policy, stable held-order ties, undirected union. No response-dependent scaling or pair selection.
scoring: Original unused repeats: final13 use repeats1:3, never-observed3 use0:3. No target truth. Independent-repeat gap noise and leave-one-repeat-out descriptive stability; retain every fixed pair.
eligibility: Source terminal probability_violation<=0.5 reported separately from empirical margins. Target acquisition joint sampled margin unavailable for source; not imputed.
statistical_unit: 24 overlapping source archive/fold/family groups, four frozen backends, two prefixes. No new independent-task or deployment inference.
limits: No source joint acquisition draw or covariance is reconstructed.
Source empirical labels from two or three repeats are not truth or certificates.
No new correction is fitted or applied; preserve positives, negatives, ties and failures.
